reviewed_by: Codex: mechanical media withholding inventory, not rights adjudication

entries.rationale: Barakat's public listing provides access to the PF.5729 photograph but no item-specific reuse licence or photographer credit. Access authentication does not establish permission.
entries.followup: Ask Barakat to identify the photographer and rights holder and to grant or decline permission for display of this exact image in Mike's Access-gated scholarly database.
